title: FlightAware Gate-Hold Hotspot
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightaware:flight
| stats avg(gate_hold_min) as avg_gate_hold_min, max(gate_hold_min) as max_gate_hold_min by origin
| where avg_gate_hold_min>15 OR max_gate_hold_min>45
| sort - avg_gate_hold_min
description: Uses FlightAware turnaround data telemetry to monitor airports where gate holds frequently slow departures in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for hubs that deserve extra buffer time, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest FlightAware turnaround data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals airports where gate holds frequently slow departures so you can spot hubs that deserve extra buffer time before it becomes annoying.
